people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “ ‘They shall have an inheritance. I am their inheritance; and you shall give them no possession in Israel. I am their possession.
translations.bsb: In regard to their inheritance, I am their inheritance. You are to give them no possession in Israel, for I am their possession.
translations.kjv: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I am their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I am their possession.
translations.asv: And they shall have an inheritance: I am their inheritance; and ye shall give them no possession in Israel; I am their possession.
